macros.name: anticommutator
macros.signature: # [doc = " Anticommutator: {a, b} = (a⊗b + b⊗a)/2 "] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! anticommutator { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { { let ab = geo ! ($ a , $ b) ; let ba = geo ! ($ b , $ a) ; (ab + ba) * 0.5 } } ; }

macros.name: commutator
macros.signature: # [doc = " Commutator: [a, b] = (a⊗b - b⊗a)/2"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! commutator { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { { let ab = geo ! ($ a , $ b) ; let ba = geo ! ($ b , $ a) ; (ab - ba) * 0.5 } } ; }

macros.name: dot
macros.signature: # [doc = " Inner product: a • b"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Symmetric product that reduces grade."] # [doc = " Commutative for vectors: a • b = b • a"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! dot { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . inner_product (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: dual
macros.signature: # [doc = " Hodge dual: ⋆a"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Maps k-vectors to (n-k)-vectors in n-dimensional space."] # [doc = " Essential for electromagnetic field theory and differential forms."] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! dual { ($ a : expr) => { $ a . hodge_dual () } ; }

macros.name: geo
macros.signature: # [doc = " Geometric product: a ⊗ b"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The fundamental product in geometric algebra that combines"] # [doc = " both inner and outer products. Also known as the Clifford product."] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! geo { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . geometric_product (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: grade
macros.signature: # [doc = " Grade projection: ⟨a⟩ₖ"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Extracts the k-grade part of a multivector."] # [doc = " Grade 0 = scalar, 1 = vector, 2 = bivector, etc."] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! grade { ($ a : expr , $ k : expr) => { $ a . grade_projection ($ k) } ; }

macros.name: lcon
macros.signature: # [doc = " Left contraction: a ⌟ b"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Generalized inner product where the grade of the result"] # [doc = " is |grade(b) - grade(a)|"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! lcon { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . left_contraction (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: norm
macros.signature: # [doc = " Magnitude/norm: ‖a‖"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Coefficient magnitude of the multivector."] # [doc = " Computed as sqrt of the sum of squared coefficients."] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! norm { ($ a : expr) => { $ a . coefficient_norm () } ; }

macros.name: norm_squared
macros.signature: # [doc = " Squared magnitude: ‖a‖²"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! norm_squared { ($ a : expr) => { $ a . norm_squared () } ; }

macros.name: rcon
macros.signature: # [doc = " Right contraction: a ⌞ b "] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Generalized inner product where the grade of the result"] # [doc = " is |grade(a) - grade(b)|"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! rcon { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . right_contraction (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: rev
macros.signature: # [doc = " Reverse/conjugate: a†"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Reverses the order of basis vectors in each term."] # [doc = " Important for defining magnitudes and inverses."] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! rev { ($ a : expr) => { $ a . reverse () } ; }

macros.name: trop_add
macros.signature: # [doc = " Tropical addition (max): a ⊕ b"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! trop_add { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . tropical_add (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: trop_mul
macros.signature: # [doc = " Tropical multiplication (addition): a ⊙ b "] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! trop_mul { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . tropical_mul (&$ b) } ; }

macros.name: unit
macros.signature: # [doc = " Unit vector: â = a/‖a‖"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! unit { ($ a : expr) => { { { let n = $ a . coefficient_norm () ; if n > 0.0 { $ a / n } else { $ a . clone () } } } } ; }

macros.name: wedge
macros.signature: # [doc = " Wedge/outer product: a ∧ b"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Creates higher-grade elements from lower-grade ones."] # [doc = " Anticommutative: a ∧ b = -(b ∧ a)"] # [macro_export] macro_rules ! wedge { ($ a : expr , $ b : expr) => { $ a . outer_product (&$ b) } ; }
